document.abstract: The SMPTE ST 2082 suite of documents defines the mapping of various source image formats onto a single-link, dual-link and quad-link serial digital interface operating at a nominal rate of 12 Gb/s. This informative “overview” describes the documents in the SMPTE ST 2082 suite.
